additional_info.subject: Note to ES Team
additional_info.body:
Problem Description:
The screensaver is not working (blue screen). The RC confirmed this issue on two units (hXcXbF & LxXnZ1). It seems the same issue may also be present on (cNkABV & 7gBgHp). Please refer to the customer's last response.
Charger SW Version
: v4.0.11
Reason for Handover (L3):
Seems need to
Install RETOPICS hotfix
Other Comment:
I asked the RC to update the charger to the latest firmware (v6.0.3), but they did not want to update the unit at this time. They are concerned that other issues may arise, especially since they are alone in the region and the other teammates are on Christmas leave.
